decision.summary: A sharp multi-axis step occurs at 607–608 (N down, U up), followed by a sustained offset interval in N and U through 620, with no confirmed return within the allowed context [575,655]. The interior (608–620) shows stable negative N and elevated U, but the absence of a clear opposing return before index 655 prevents confirmation. E does not support a coherent temporary offset. Thus, only one uncertain temporary offset interval is identified.

intervals.observation: N drops sharply at 607–608 (from ~-0.5 to ~-2.2), then remains negative (~-1.5 to -3.5) through 620; U rises concurrently (from ~0.5 to ~1.0–2.5) and stays elevated until 620; E shows no coherent trend but fluctuates moderately. Return not observed within allowed context (ends at 655, but N/U remain offset at 655: N≈-2.96, U≈1.25). No clear opposing reversal before end of context.
